proposed_definition_changes.reason: The preliminary set \( [0,1]\cap 2m\operatorname{CP}_{\gamma_0/(4m)}\{K_{xa}(z);n\} \) can be empty on a positive-probability sample, for example when \(K_{xa}(z)=n\) and the Clopper--Pearson lower endpoint exceeds \(1/(2m)\). Its lower and upper endpoints are then undefined, so the frozen construction is not total. Replacing only such an empty intersection by \(\{0\}\) changes nothing on the simultaneous coverage event, gives a defined downstream Hall region on every sample, and has zero off-event diameter for the stochastic-width argument.
